_comment: Four tier SKUs (team/business/scale/enterprise) ARE priced, from the v3
carries a real Stripe Price (price_id) and the matching amount_cents.
The fifteen a-la-carte SKUs below stay unset on purpose: no documented
price exists for any of them. A SKU becomes sellable only once BOTH
price_id (a real Stripe Price) and amount_cents are filled in - see
catalog.py Sku.configured. Until then the storefront shows 'price not set'
and checkout refuses with a reason. Nothing here guesses a price.
